-81.09960,32.02760.name: The Georgia Center for Reproductive Medicine
-81.09960,32.02760.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Patrick L. Blohm, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-0.08642,51.50444.name: Lister Fertility Clinic at The Shard
-0.08642,51.50444.state: The Shard, St Thomas Street, London, SE1 9BS
-0.08642,51.50444.company: Satellite clinic to The Lister Fertility Clinic
-0.08642,51.50444.desc: A fertility clinic licensed and inspected by the Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority. Satellite clinic to The Lister Fertility Clinic. A satellite is where patients are seen; the licence sits with the parent clinic, so the regulator's paperwork and the treatment are in different places. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. The HFEA licenses every clinic in the United Kingdom, inspects them, and publishes findings and success rates clinic by clinic. No other fertility regulator publishes at this level, which makes the UK the one country where this sector can be read rather than estimated.

-99.20100,19.42000.name: Grupo Bimbo
-99.20100,19.42000.state: Mexico City — Prolongación Paseo de la Reforma 1000
-99.20100,19.42000.desc: The largest bakery company in the world, buying wheat and maize at a scale that makes its procurement policy a de facto regulation. A miller or baker of this size deciding not to accept an engineered grain closes the market for it more effectively than any regulator — which is why engineered wheat went unapproved for twenty-five years while the science sat ready.
